links.outcome: Agreement of model answers across prompt rephrasing and removal of option labels
links.effect: All six models were highly sensitive to prompt phrasing (max Cohen's κ = 0.55) and to label removal (highest κ = 0.35). High consistency across responses did not indicate correctness.
links.quote: All models exhibited high sensitivity to prompt phrasing (maximum level of agreement Cohen’s κ = 0.55) and to label removal (highest Cohen’s κ = 0.35).

unlisted_practices: Testing LLM self-assessment bias and dependence on the order of candidate explanations when selecting correct reasoning
Evaluating the relationship between response consistency and correctness under stochastic inference settings

screen.reason: Evaluates small open-source medical LLMs on pediatric endocrinology cases looking at consistency, robustness to prompt perturbations, and reasoning behavior, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or organizational practice.
